exposure: perceived effectiveness of LEA in relieving pain
healthcare providers as source of information
outcome: decision/willingness to consider labor epidural analgesia (LEA) during delivery
cohort: 230 pregnant women with a mean age of 29.9 years.
finding: While awareness of labor epidural analgesia (LEA) was relatively high (78%), only 14.3% of pregnant women expressed willingness to consider using it during delivery, with education level, family income, perceived fetal risk, and perceived pain relief effectiveness identified as influencing factors.
cross-section timing: Data collected from June 03 to August 30, 2024, among pregnant women.
